page_title: ATM 2-1 VAL | Atletico Madrid v Valencia 13/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+3' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90+2' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Cesar Soto Grado and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' Having seen unsporting behavior, Cesar Soto Grado shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Diego Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is the recipient.
88' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
82' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Pepelu and he is replaced by Largie Ramazani (Valencia).
82' Substitution. Jesus Vazquez is replaced by Jose Gaya (Valencia).
78' Here comes the VAR decision. NO GOAL, the ref disallows it due to offside.
78' Atl. Madrid score a goal, but the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
78' Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) has a reason to celebrate.
77' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Valencia.
76' The attendance is 61011.

74' 2 - 1 What a wonderful finish! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and smashes the ball inside the left post. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
74' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
72' Carlos Corberan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javi Guerra (Valencia) replacing Filip Ugrinic.
71' Carlos Corberan is forced to make a change. Eray Comert (Valencia) is unable to continue due to injury, Baptiste Santamaria comes on.
71' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
67' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.

63' 1 - 1 The defending players give Lucas Beltran (Valencia) far too much free space and he knows how to take advantage of it. He produces a howitzer in the direction of the left side of the target. Jan Oblak was taken unawares by his effort and the score is 1:1.
59' Here is a change. Pablo Barrios is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid).
59' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) replaces Julian Alvarez.
59' The referee signals a substitution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Gonzalez.
58' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
56' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Lopez departs the field of play to be replaced by Lucas Beltran (Valencia).

52' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Julen Agirrezabala shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
50' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes.
48' Andre Almeida (Valencia) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
47' Andre Almeida (Valencia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) comes on the pitch for Nahuel Molina.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Cesar Soto Grado has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Jan Oblak leaps to intercept the corner kick from Andre Almeida (Valencia).
45+2' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Great teamplay by Atl. Madrid as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
42' The foul by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Cesar Soto Grado.

41' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Atl. Madrid are taking a throw-in.
40' The possession of the ball – 46:54.
38' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) strikes a first-time shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper denies him with an excellent save.
37' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Valencia players look gutted.
36' The Valencia players halt their celebrations as referee Cesar Soto Grado makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
34' Pepelu (Valencia) takes advantage of a goalmouth scramble by calmly slotting the ball into the bottom left corner of the net!
34' Valencia take a short corner kick.
32' Yellow card. Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
31' Cesar Soto Grado couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) and blew his whistle.
31' Hugo Duro (Valencia) collects the ball from the free kick and immediately sends his close-range effort just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
30' Rough tackle by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia have a free kick.

29' Eray Comert (Valencia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Cesar Soto Grado blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
28' Andre Almeida (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
26' The Valencia players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
24' Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. It's a throw-in for Valencia.
23' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
23' Andre Almeida (Valencia) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
22' Hugo Duro received a clever long ball from Julen Agirrezabala (Valencia) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
20' Atl. Madrid hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
17' 1 - 0 Goal! Koke (Atl. Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
17' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
16' Valencia are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error. The ball is behind the touchline and Atl. Madrid will take a throw-in.
15' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.

13' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Julen Agirrezabala makes a great save. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
13' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
10' Thierry Correia (Valencia) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
8' Giuliano Simeone latches onto a perfect defence-splitting pass from Koke (Atl. Madrid) and heads towards goal.
7' A pass by Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The linesman signals a throw-in for Valencia.
5' A spell of possession for Valencia in an attempt to control the game.
4' Pepelu (Valencia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Cesar Soto Grado blows his whistle for a foul.
3' A cross into the box from Thierry Correia (Valencia) is cleared.
3' The Atl. Madrid players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
2' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Cesar Soto Grado has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.

1' Crossbar! Hugo Duro (Valencia) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
Cesar Soto Grado got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
